name: - AES (Deflationary token)
fix_description: distributeFee is public and directly transfers tokens from the LP pair to multiple wallets. Fix: add access control (onlyOwner) to distributeFee, or remove the direct pair balance manipulation — instead swap tokens through the router. Also add rate limiting so accumulated fees cannot be distributed all at once after manipulation via skim.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short multi-step price/accounting manipulation using a flash loan, AMM pair skim/sync behavior, and a protocol-specific fee distribution function. It is not a trivial access-control bug, but it also does not require a deeply complex cross-protocol chain or advanced state reasoning beyond understanding tokenomics plus UniswapV2 pair mechanics.
